non_claims: the aglycone skeleton (furofuran versus tetrahydrofuran) is decided by the precursor composition, not by these ions
the hexose identity and its anomeric configuration are not resolved
in furofurans, which of the two C7-linked guaiacyl rings carries the sugar is not resolved

isobars of the sodiated targets with C2 for NaH (C15H17O7+ 2.4 mDa from 309.0945, C8H9O5+ 2.4 mDa from 185.0420) lie inside the p2 tolerance, so the [M+H]+, [M+NH4]+ and [M+K]+ hypotheses tried under adduct_ambiguous can match these Na-containing targets

notes: Only the sodiated guaiacyl hexoside 309 separates these 4-O-glucosides from the isomeric 8-O-glucoside, which also gives 185 and the 162 loss (Ricci 2008 Table 1), so the claim rests on one ion and the rule is not measured.

competitors.note: The 8-O-glucoside gives 185 (100), the 162 loss and 203 without 309 (rcm.3746 Table 1); the 7'-O-glucoside gives 203, 137 and a 180 loss without 309 (rcm.4472 p. 981).

priors.note: [M+H]+ of these glucosides is absent or very weak and K+, Rb+ and Cs+ adducts give only the metal ion, so the rule lists [M+Na]+ alone; the common adducts are still tried under adduct_ambiguous.
